name: Battam
source:
A witch who specializes in fortune telling. He's convinced that him and Sal were lovers in a past life. Whether that's true or not is yet to be seen. Has a spooky face, but an extremely kind soul.

[From [url=https://darkchibishadow.itch.io/solanaceae-another-time]itch.io[/url]]
